subject: Vendr portal: requested upload window and field mapping
messages:
From: Ava Langford <ava.langford@greenfieldbiotech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@greenfieldbiotech.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal — bulk upload window request and field questions

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for the Vendr invite. We're starting to consolidate our SOC 2 / CAIQ artifacts and want to do a bulk upload into Vendr this week. A couple quick asks so we can plan: 

- Do you have a recommended two-hour upload window (UTC offsets noted below)? Our team will stage files (PDFs, syslog samples, KMS rotation screenshots) and we'd like to avoid token expiry during the window.
- Can you confirm the exact field names you expect in the manifest CSV (control_id, evidence_type, expiration_date, owner_email) — we have a few internal fields that don't map cleanly.
- Are there any limits on file size or filename characters we should be aware of?

We can run the upload from our SFTP client if you provide an ephemeral presign or temporary creds. If easier, we can use the Vendr UI. Proposed windows (our TZ = PDT):
  * Mon 26 Jul, 10:00-12:00 PDT (17:00-19:00 UTC)
  * Tue 27 Jul, 07:00-09:00 PDT (14:00-16:00 UTC)

Attached is a preliminary CSV listing (greenfield_vendr_upload_list.csv) so you can see how our fields look.

Appreciate the help — we want to minimize back-and-forth during the upload.

Thanks,
Ava Langford
Head of Compliance
Greenfield Biotech

Attachments: greenfield_vendr_upload_list.csv (CSV - 42 rows)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Langford <ava.langford@greenfieldbiotech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal — bulk upload window request and field questions

Ava — thanks for the CSV and the proposed windows. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answers:
- We can support either window; Kimberly (portal ops) prefers Mon 26 Jul 10:00-12:00 PDT.
- Manifest template: we require these exact column headers: control_id, evidence_type, evidence_id, upload_filename, owner_email, effective_date, expiration_date, confidentiality_level. I attached our template (redwood_vendr_manifest_template.csv).
- File size: Vendr accepts up to 250MB per file; prefer ASCII/UTF-8 filenames, avoid pipes and emojis.
- Upload method: we can provide a temporary S3 presign keyed to a one-hour upload window or enable a vendor upload role in Vendr UI. For bulk >200 files we recommend S3 presign.

If Mon works I will:
1) Reserve the Vendr slot and enable a one-hour presign window starting at 10:15 PDT (we'll stagger uploads to avoid throttling).
2) Share the presign instructions and a short upload checklist (vendr_upload_instructions.pdf).
3) Run a quick pre-check on your CSV mapping and flag mismatches — Kimberly, can you look at their sample and call out anything that will need normalization?

Kimberly: assigning the CSV in a follow-up.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendr_manifest_template.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ava Langford <ava.langford@greenfieldbiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal — bulk upload window request and field questions

Ava / Sean — I reviewed greenfield_vendr_upload_list.csv. Highlights:

- control_id: several rows use combined control labels (e.g., "CC-1 / CC-2"); please split into one control_id per row or add a mapping column.
- evidence_type: we accept pdf, log, screenshot, csv; map "docx" -> pdf before upload.
- owner_email: two entries use group aliases (compliance@gf). We need an individual owner or a mapped alias list.

I'll prepare a short normalization script you can run locally and return the cleaned CSV if you want — saves time during the window.

Ava — can you confirm who will be the upload lead and whether you want S3 presign or Vendr UI? If presign, we'll send the presign list & TTL notes (s3-presign-notes.txt).

Kimberly Park
Portal Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Ava Langford <ava.langford@greenfieldbiotech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, security@greenfieldbiotech.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal — bulk upload window request and field questions

Thanks — Mon 26 Jul 10:00-12:00 PDT works for us.

Upload lead: I will run the S3-based upload with one of our SREs (name: Marco Diaz, marco.diaz@greenfieldbiotech.com). Please send the presign tokens and the upload checklist. We'll run the normalization script you mentioned and return a cleaned CSV by 09:30 PDT Monday.

For planning: we anticipate ~180 files, mostly pdfs and a handful of zipped log bundles (~120MB each). If you see anything risky in that mix please call it out.

Appreciate the coordination — sending Marco on CC in a separate thread to join the upload.

Best,
Ava
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Langford <ava.langford@greenfieldbiotech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 14:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendr upload confirmed — presign & checklist attached

Ava / Marco (cc'd on separate thread) — confirmed for Mon 26 Jul 10:15-11:15 PDT (we'll stagger). Actions completed: 

- Created one-hour S3 presign window (instructions attached: vendr_upload_instructions.pdf).
- Uploaded the presign manifest keys to your email (you'll receive a secure link at 09:55 PDT).
- Attached our final manifest template and s3 presign TTL notes.

Please run your normalization script and send the cleaned CSV to me before 09:30 PDT. During the window we'll monitor ingress and reopen a channel for immediate fixes.

If you hit any permission errors, reply-all and we'll escalate to infra within 10 minutes.

Thanks — see you tomorrow.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
